source.member: Player.AddSalvage(List<WorldObject>, WorldObject, SalvageResults) over a sequence
source.notes: The first case's in.bag_weenies are the salvage-bag weenies in DatabaseManager.World (ItemType TinkeringMaterial, MaxStructure 100, WeenieType CraftTool, Name 'Salvage', plus the listed ints). in.overages sets salvage_handle_overages; in.items are salvaged in order into one bag list, as HandleSalvaging does (items are not consumed here). out.bags lists each bag [wcid, Structure, ItemWorkmanship, NumItemsInMaterial, Value, Name, MaterialType]; out.messages as salvage_structure's; out.items each item's [NumItemsInMaterial, ItemWorkmanship] afterwards. Inputs from System.Random(5907).
